purpose: Create a rules-only natural Crazyhouse opening corpus for the owner-required local same-network paired gate while keeping rare-rule correctness coverage distinct from match-book weighting.

correction_basis.disclosure: These EP counts were observed during rules-only v1 engineering diagnostics before this v2 design. No engine output, network evaluation, match result, score, timing, Elo or strength information was observed or used.

reference.required_checkout_state: exact detached clean checkout with loaded module below that checkout

selection_contract.seed_utf8: Crazyhouse-Stockfish local same-network opening corpus v1
selection_contract.choice_algorithm: Sort the complete legal move set by UCI text. Hash seed || NUL || uint64be(candidate_index) || uint16be(ply) with SHA-256. Interpret the full digest as a big-endian integer modulo the legal move count.
terminal_rejections: checkmate before or at target depth
stalemate before or at target depth
fivefold repetition before or at target depth
selection_contract.duplicate_rejection_key: board placement including promoted flags and pockets, turn, castling rights and legal en-passant field
selection_contract.canonical_output: six-field bracket-pocket FEN with PNBRQpnbrq pocket order and legal-only en-passant

ep_metric_definitions.raw_ep_target_set: python-chess board.ep_square is non-null after the immediately preceding double pawn step, irrespective of whether any capture is pseudo-legal or legal
ep_metric_definitions.legal_en_passant_available: python-chess board.has_legal_en_passant() is true and the canonical legal-only FEN retains the target

must_pin: reference commit/tree/module/license blob and filtered checkout identity

transition_test.assertion: legal en-passant capture pockets the captured pawn

allowed_changes_from_commit_6bc9ee77: version output schema, artifact ID and default logical paths from v1 to v2
publish separate raw, pseudo-legal and legal EP fields
replace the invalid v1 legal_ep threshold with the exact v2 metric assertions above
forbidden_changes: target count, target depths or depth balance
reference commit, rule profile or canonical FEN policy
engine, evaluator, network or match-result input

qualification_requirements: Generate twice into one fresh formal namespace and require byte-identical EPD, JSONL and manifest outputs.
Run the generator verifier independently over both copies.
Replay every trajectory from the standard Crazyhouse start position in the exact pinned python-chess checkout.
Authenticate all 1024 EPD rows through the exact qualified referee conformance parser.
Run one fixed-node, non-timing referee dry pair from the generated book and prove the same opening with swapped colors.
Require the exact candidate and adapted comparator to load the exact legacy network and return a legal bestmove on the dry pair.
Preserve raw stdout, stderr, PGN, generated files and per-file SHA-256 in the formal completion.

generated_data_license.dedication: To the extent possible under law, the Crazyhouse-Stockfish contributors waive all copyright and related or neighboring rights in this generated corpus.

resource_contract.foreign_process_policy: read-only; no stop, suspend, resume, affinity or priority changes

pass_effect: Only the exact generated v2 opening corpus becomes eligible for the separately frozen local panel. Time control, adapter overhead, host cleanliness, match schedule and strength remain independent gates.
fail_effect: Preserve the formal namespace, emit an immutable result, and do not substitute v1 or the quarantined historical book.
